programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Musical Bears. The band are too ill to play in the show, so the Three Bears step in to help - but they're not sure how to play the instruments!

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Spectacular Sparkly Night. Love Monster tries to face his fear of loud bangs so he can enjoy the Spectacular Sparkly Night fireworks display with his friends.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Hoop. Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Jingly Shoes. Children's animation. Bing finds his old baby shoes. They are much too small for Bing now, but when they fit baby Charlie he has a hard time letting them go.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: p. Dee encourages a friend to say 'p', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We eat some popcorn and pizza, and even have a pyjama party!

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Find the Blueberries. Lu and Biba accidentally rig their treasure hunt game.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Green Thumb. Brian asks the Piggies to help grow a special little plant. With time, care and lots of love, they're amazed to see it grow incredibly big!

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: Inside. Stop-motion preschool programme about the adventures of four inquisitive Twirlywoos. The Twirlywoos see a man putting something inside his tent, and they get carried away.

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Down on the Farm. Justin and his friends meet a chicken, while Mr Tumble finds a worm.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Custard Chaos. Preschool series. The Tubby Custard Machine careers crazily out of Home Dome and goes on a messy ride around Teletubbyland.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Shops. Nigel and Baby Bear encourage grown-ups and their babies to explore shopping-themed toys and objects, through discovery, play, song and story time. Everyone at home can join in too!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Honey. Kiri and Lou get in a sticky situation when they seek honey for Anahera's sore throat.

programme.title: Maddie & Triggs
programme.desc: Pearly Whites. Maddie meets her very own pearly whites and finds music in brushing her teeth.

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: Road Worker. Dylan the road worker wants to help drivers get where they need to go. When a little pothole becomes a big road block, he has to find a way to bridge the gap!

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Treetops. Ginger is stuck in a tree, so the Pea-Rexes seek the tallest Vegesaurs to rescue her.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Pirates. It's an adventure on the high seas as Bluey, Bingo and Missy play pirates on the hammock swing. They'll need to find their courage to withstand storms and whale attacks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Library Badge. When the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting Duggee's library, they have an idea. A mobile library!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
programme.desc: Campfire Choir. Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Grapefruit. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Grapefruit dedicating the song All My Friends to the close pals who go with her everywhere.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Timmy Plays Ball. The class learns how to play football, but Timmy keeps hogging the ball. Ruffy and Paxton soon get bored, leaving Timmy to play football with a not-very-athletic Otus.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Lantern Parade. Oliver and Felicity make lanterns with their faces on for the school's lantern parade.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Eric the Explorer. Eric the Explorer visits the cafe for something to eat, so they cook him something unusual.

programme.title: Aneeshwar and Lizzie Go Wild
programme.desc: Indian Peafowl and Gorilla. Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet two amazing animals and reveal the surprising ways in which they are connected in the wild. This time, it's peacocks and gorillas.

programme.title: What's in Your Bag?
programme.desc: Swimmer. Swimmer Maisie, a Paralympic gold medallist, tells us how her swimming cap helps her to go faster.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Mission: Last Minute Visitor. Disability assistance dog Tinks and her owner Charli have a long list of chores to do, all in time for Annabel, their last minute visitor!

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Skyscraper and Flying Bird. Maddie learns how skyscrapers are made and visits a bird sanctuary to see how birds fly.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Tree. Dee encourages a friend to say 'tree', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see a prickly tree, a tickly tree and even meet a friendly family of trees.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Stampolines. Children's animation. Three opens a stampoline park, where her friends have splatty fun making inky prints of all the shapes they can make.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Box. The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. B, O and X discover a box filled with everything they need to put on a performance.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Tower of Flowers. Go wants to surprise Toad by making a colourful flower tower for his garden. Can Arty and the Do Blocks help create a splatting pattern that matches it?

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Red Meets Blue. Red discovers that she's not the only colour in the world when she meets Blue. Learn which objects can be red and which can be blue, and how some can be both red and blue.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The A Cappella Badge. The Squirrels are inspired to learn how to sing a cappella style after hearing a famous bird quartet singing in a nearby tree.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Chrysalis Creche. TapTap becomes very protective when strange eggs appear in the branches of her tree, so everyone helps to keep the garden nice and quiet.

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Waving. Preschool series. After a fun waving game with the Tiddlytubbies, the Teletubbies enjoy watching children waving as they set off on a short boat trip.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Camptosaurus and Call. Preschool adventure series. Andy travels 150 million years back in time to track down the peculiar camptosaurus.

programme.title: Topsy and Tim

programme.title: What's on Your Head?
programme.desc: Cycling. In this episode, Charlie, the youngest person to ever cycle around the world, tells us all about why he loves wearing his cycling helmet.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion

programme.title: New: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: Making Mistakes Can Be Fun! The Game Catchers land on an ancient Greece planet to play jump the rubber band.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: How to Work Together. Dad shares his explorer notebook with Cosima and Big Lizard.

programme.title: Supertato

programme.title: Peter Rabbit

programme.title: Bluey

programme.desc: Socraíonn an Máistir Báite & an Mháistreás Máilléad an saol a dhéanamh thar a bheith deacair ar Dhónall. (Máistir Báite & Máistreás Máilléad try to make Dónall's life difficult.)

programme.title: Cúla4
programme.desc: Níl aon easpa cláracha do dhaoine óga ar Cúla4 - bí ag spraoi agus ag foghlaim in éineacht linn. (Younger audiences will be spoilt for choice with Cúla4 - watch, play and learn.)

programme.title: Super Simple Amhráin
programme.desc: Amhrán spraíúil faoi fhéileacán, bóín Dé agus bumbóg a bheidh againn inniu. (A fun song about a Butterfly, a Ladybug & a Bumblebee.)

programme.title: Blocuimhreacha
programme.desc: Tagann Ochtabloc chun cabhrú lena chuid cairde nua. (The Terrible Twos are making custard pies and Octoblock is all tied up: can his friends save the day?)

programme.title: Blocdhathanna
programme.desc: Na dathanna áille atá le fáil sa gcoill a bheidh againn inniu. (Today, we get to see all the beautiful Colours that we can find in the forest.)

programme.title: Pramsáil
programme.desc: Téann Caitríona agus Roy chuig an trá agus bíonn an-spraoi acu ag casadh agus ag damhsa. (Caitríona and Roy go to the beach, and they have a great time singing and dancing.)

programme.title: Lá Le Mamó nó Daideo
programme.desc: Tá Déithín leis an lá a chaitheamh in éineacht lena Mamó Mairéad Lá Fhéile Pádraig. (It's St. Patricks Day and Déithín is getting ready to spend the day with her Mamó Mairéad.)

programme.title: Ó a Sheáin
programme.desc: Balún bán, balún buí, banana, buicéad agus bosca bruscair a bheidh ag déanamh imní do Sheán inniu. (Seán goes to the shop today and has an adventure.)

programme.title: Garáiste Gecko
programme.desc: Tá fiacail scaoilte ag Babaí Trucail agus cuirtear an gas mícheart i mboinn Max. (Baby has a wobbly tooth, and Max's tyres are filled with the wrong gas.)

programme.title: Béiríní is a Leabhair
programme.desc: Cailleann Lasairín foighne nuair a sháinnítear na Béiríní sna creaga lá báistí. (Lasairín is frustrated when the Bears are trapped under a rocky outcrop in a rainstorm.)

programme.title: Béiríní is a Leabhair
programme.desc: Smaoiníonn Gobnait ar bhealaí iontacha le spraoi a bhaint as maide. (The Bears explore some imaginative ways to play with a stick.)

programme.title: Pikwik Pack
programme.desc: Níl na Bíosúin in ann rud ar bith a fháil sa trucail taco. (At the Taco Truck, the Bison Brothers are flustered.)

programme.title: Nuair a Bheidh Mé Mór
programme.desc: Samhlaíonn Ruarc a shaol ina fhiaclóir nuair a bheidh sé mór, le cúnamh ó Shióg na bPost. (Ruarc imagines his life as a dentist when he grows up, with the help of the Job Fairy.)

programme.title: Zou
programme.desc: Beidh tuilleadh eachtraí ag Zou agus a chairde inniu. (Zou and his friends have more adventures today.)

programme.title: Dee Dee
programme.desc: Tá go leor litreacha le seachadadh ag uncail Charlie ach níl mórán ama aige. (Charlie has a lot of post to deliver today but doesn't have a lot of time.)

programme.title: Is Mise
programme.desc: Beidh Sibéal ag déanamh fleasc earraigh as ábhar athchúrsáilte inniu. (Today, Sibéal will be making a spring wreath out of recycled materials.)

programme.title: Ainmhithe Craiceáilte
programme.desc: Madra & racún ag tarraingt téide & cait óga ag déanamh obair tí a bheidh againn inniu. (On today's show we have a dog & a raccoon playing tug-o-war & kittens doing housework.)

programme.title: Comhrá
programme.desc: Is í Mary O'Toole a bheidh ag comhrá le Máirtín Tom Sheáinín ar an gclár. (Máirtín Tom Sheáinín will be chatting with Mary O'Toole on the show.)

programme.title: The Wonder Years
programme.desc: Cuireann Paul ina luí ar Kevin a ainm féin a chur ar an mballóid d'Uachtarán Chomhairle na Mac Léinn. (Paul convinces Kevin to run for Student Council President.)

programme.title: Geantraí
programme.desc: Beidh Eamonn Cotter, Canny Kelly agus Peter O'Loughlin i measc na gceoltóirí ar an gclár. (A music session featuring Eamonn Cotter, Canny Kelly and Peter O'Loughlin.)

programme.title: The Golden Girls
programme.desc: Tá galar Alzheimer ar chara nua Sophia. (Sophia's new friend, an elderly man, suffers from Alzheimer's disease.)

programme.title: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: Cuirtear dúnmharú i leith fhear a bhfuil na mná uile in Cabot Cove craiceáilte ina dhiaidh. (A fitness instructor who has captivated Cabot Cove's women is linked to the murder.)

programme.title: Rúin ón Spéir

programme.title: Viva Ceol Tíre

programme.title: Shark Tank
